profile.summary: Mediscan Staffing Services is a staffing and recruiting firm, founded in 1995, that places allied health professionals and school-based specialists with healthcare facilities and schools. It supplies staff to special education departments. It has since been rebranded as Cross Country Education under Cross Country Healthcare.
